title: Chapter 48: Big Knife Skeleton King
content:
Chapter 48: Big Knife Skeleton King

The Skeleton King with a Big Knife still stood there proudly, as if waiting for Wang Shuo to challenge him.

There is nothing to say!

Just do it!

Wang Shuo arranged some tactics. Gong Zheng was responsible for attracting firepower, which would be stressful, so he gave him 5 bottles of small red medicine so that he could replenish himself when his health dropped.

The Golden Armor Warrior served as the main output, after all, it had the highest attack power.

The battle started soon.

Wang Shuo bent his bow and put an arrow on it. With a "swoosh", the iron arrow cut through the sky and hit the target.

A "-25" damage floated above the Skeleton King with a Big Knife. He immediately turned his head and looked in the direction of the attack.

Finding that someone dared to attack him, he rushed towards Wang Shuo with some anger.

Gong Zheng immediately took the lead and fought back with a big iron shield.

After Gong Zheng's level was upgraded, Wang Shuo allocated his free attribute points to physique and strength in a ratio of 2:1. At this time, his defense power was greatly improved compared to the beginning.

Moreover, he also has the buff bonus of "Brothers United", and his attributes have been strengthened again, and his defense is higher than that of the Golden Armor Warrior.

Gong Zheng withstood the first collision, and he and the Skeleton King each took a step back, which was considered to be evenly matched.

This made Wang Shuo feel relieved, and at the same time he was amazed at the defense of the Big Knife Skeleton King.

Afterwards, everyone began to output in an orderly manner, with the Golden Armor Warrior as the main force, and Wang Shuo and the other two brothers as auxiliary, cooperating with each other.

For a time, the Big Knife Skeleton King was exhausted from parrying and had little power to fight back. All attacks were blocked by the big shield.

It's just that the durability of the iron shield dropped very quickly. With the support of Gong Zheng's "blocking" skill, Wang Shuo was quite satisfied.

At present, it is a one-sided situation. As long as there is no accident, this boss will be eliminated soon.

But the accident still happened. Of course, this accident was within Wang Shuo's expectations.

As a boss, there must be burst skills.

Suddenly, the sword of the Skeleton King of the Big Knife burst out with a burst of golden light, and instantly split Gong Zheng's big shield in half.

"Charge a strike."

This is an important skill of the Skeleton King of the Big Knife, and Gong Zheng was instantly knocked out.

Wang Shuo's pupils suddenly dilated, and he looked at Gong Zheng with some worry, and found that the opponent climbed up, and his blood volume only dropped by 100, which seemed to be just injured by the shock.

Without the big iron shield, the pressure on Wang Shuo's team doubled, but the blood volume of the Skeleton King of the Big Knife was not much, which gave Wang Shuo hope.

"Golden armor warrior, go!"

Wang Shuo shouted loudly, and at this time only it could withstand the boss's damage, exchanging durability for output, which was also a helpless move.

Gong Zheng also took out the shield that Wang Shuo gave him at the beginning, but this small shield was much worse in defense than the big iron shield.

Just when everyone was besieging, the Skeleton King of the Big Knife used a move of "sweeping thousands of troops", and Wang Shuo and others were all repelled, and everyone was injured.

The situation suddenly took a turn for the worse. The Skeleton King with the Big Knife attacked the fallen Gong Ping directly. If he hit him with this knife, Gong Ping, who was at low health, would surely die.

At this critical moment, Gong Zheng immediately blocked it with his shield.

Gong Zheng was injured again, and his health had dropped to a dangerous level.

Wang Shuo's heart was in his throat, and he stabbed with his gun. Since he had no skills, he could only attack normally, and the damage was limited.

At this time, the golden armored warrior also seized the opportunity, jumped into the air, and with a leap and a powerful blow, he instantly repelled the Skeleton King with the Big Knife, and caused huge damage.

At this point, the battle came to an end. Wang Shuo directly ordered Gong Zheng, who was seriously injured, to withdraw from the battle and seize the time to recover his health on the side.

After releasing the skills, the Skeleton King obviously had a weak period.

Wang Shuo and others kept covering each other and causing him damage.

After a while, Wang Shuo saw the right opportunity and stabbed its skull with a gun, clearing its health.

[You killed the Skeleton King with the Big Knife. 】

After the system prompt sounded, Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

[The task of killing the broadsword skeleton king is completed. You can find the quartermaster Zhao Bangde to receive the reward. 】

[Your level has been upgraded to level 8. 】

Wang Shuo found that several of his subordinates had also been upgraded. Since the last upgrade, they have killed many more skeleton soldiers. In addition to this boss, the level upgrade is not surprising!

Wang Shuo walked over and picked up the items dropped on the ground.

[Soul Crystal +1, Energy Crystal +15, Broadsword +1]

A weapon was actually exploded, which made Wang Shuo a little happy.

[Broadsword: Excellent weapon, strength +10, attack power +20, durability: 100/100]

It turned out to be an excellent-level broadsword. It seems to be the weapon used by the broadsword skeleton king.

Wang Shuo felt a little regretful. If it was a gun, he could use it himself.

However, it was also very good to be able to improve the strength of his subordinates, so he directly gave it to Gong Kai.

Gong Kai, who got the broadsword, did not show any emotional changes.

A tool man really does not deserve to have an expression.

At this time, Wang Shuo checked Gong Kai's character information.

He found that there were actually two attribute panels.

One is the basic attribute panel, and the other is the combat attribute panel.

[Basic attribute panel]

[ID: SAC56789537 Gong Kai]

[Level: Level 5]

[Strength: 25]

[Constitution: 10]

[Agility: 7]

[Energy: 5]

(Qualification: B level, each level provides 4 free attribute points.)

This kind of growth made Wang Shuo feel a little inferior to himself. He seemed to have upgraded to level 1 and only had 1 free attribute, which was really embarrassing.

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 25+20]

[Defense: 8]

[Health value: 600]

[Skill: Heavy attack]

[Equipment (broad-backed sword): sophisticated weapon, strength +10, attack power +20, durability: 100/100] (Main equipment)

This broad-backed sword can be said to be a small masterpiece, which greatly improved Gong Kai's combat effectiveness.

Wang Shuo smiled happily.

I checked the other two brothers and found that they were roughly the same, except that they didn't have the best weapons and the various values were a little lower.

The qualifications are all B level.

After a short rest, Gong Zheng's condition returned to normal.

Wang Shuo began to sweep away in the direction of the camp.

From afar, Wang Shuo shouted to Bond Zhao: "Old Zhao, I defeated the Skeleton King with the Sword!"

"Well, not bad, not bad!" Zhao Bond also showed a smile of appreciation.

According to his prediction, Wang Shuo should be able to defeat this boss tomorrow.

"This is your reward."

[Cavalry Squad Medal +1, Military Merit Points +500]

[Cavalry Squad Medal: After players wear it, they can form a 10-man cavalry squad. 】

After Wang Shuo equipped it, he found that there was no corresponding system prompt.

He looked at Zhao Bond in confusion.

"That's because you haven't become a cavalry yet. Once you have a combat profession and open the command panel, you can form your own cavalry team."

"So that's it!"

Wang Shuo thought thoughtfully, thinking that in the battle for the "Village Building Order", he must change his job as soon as possible, so that he can form a strong combat effectiveness.
